description: TRACKRV-HZB-VISIBILITY-OPUS-1 Hi-Z depth pyramid build + diagnostic occlusion probe. MC2_HZB_BUILD is the pyramid-build gate (default-OFF); MC2_HZB_PROBE is the diagnostic readback probe gate (default-OFF, requires MC2_HZB_BUILD). Neither gate suppresses draws — both are diagnostic substrate only. The depth/reduction contract is locked in docs/hzb-depth-convention.md + tests/unit/test_depth_hzb.cpp (reverse-Z, ZERO_TO_ONE, near=1/far=0, MIN-reduce pyramid).

entries.description: Baseline — both HZB gates OFF. No pyramid built, no probe runs. Byte-identical to pre-HZB output.
HZB pyramid build enabled (MC2_HZB_BUILD=1). Reverse-Z MIN-reduction pyramid is built each frame from MainDepth; diagnostic substrate only — no culling, no draw suppression.

HZB pyramid build + diagnostic occlusion probe (MC2_HZB_BUILD=1 + MC2_HZB_PROBE=1). Probe reads back a parent/child HZB level pair, verifies MIN-reduction integrity, and logs would-cull/would-keep/mismatch counters. NEVER suppresses a draw.
